data.headline: Engineering Director at Medtronic
data.about:
Medtronic Summary
•	Program Leadership - Core Team Leader of many Implantable, Instrument and SW programs.
•	Extensive Achievement Record delivering complex products through full product development cycle including many world’s firsts.  Track record of successfully recovering large, troubled programs.
•	Medical Device Process Expertise with QMS regulations, industry standards and CRHF processes ensuring highest quality and compliance.  
•	Team Builder focused on relationships across the matrix, people management and execution.
•	Strong Communicator achieving cross organizational and functional alignment as well as inclusion 
of our large worldwide SW workforce.

description.text:
	Monitors Technology Development Leader (May 2021 – present)
New Patient Management role owning bedside and mobile monitor strategy and product and technology roadmaps to deliver prioritized stakeholder outcomes.  
	SW Portfolio Delivery (May 2018 – April 2021)
As ‘Face to Business’, owned SW intake, estimation and delivery for multiple business units.  Coached and mentored SW Core Team Members to next level of performance.
Defined, estimated, and procured capital funding for SW and instrument ecosystem to support next generation of implantables.  
Owned preventative CAPA end to end for new 82304 mobile SW standard.
Developed multi-year strategy to build large MDT SW presence in India.  
	MyCareLink Heart Mobile Monitor PDM, (May 2017 – April 2018)
Delivered novel blue tooth patient mobile monitor application after previous R&D attempts failed.

Lead cross-organizational teams comprised of Development, Quality, Marketing, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, and Clinical to design, manufacture and market release implantable medical device products and instrument and application SW.  Responsible for strategic direction; aligning scope, cost, and schedule with business leadership; and leading teams through full product development lifecycle, regulatory approvals, and world-wide release.
	SmartSync Device Manager (March 2014 – Apr 2017)
Led large 200 person WW team on very forward looking HW/FW/SW and Regulatory concept and solution that utilized commercial off the shelf tablets, OS independence, public App stores and wireless communication via Bluetooth.
	Advisa SR MRI SureScan Pacemaker (Apr 2013 – Feb 2014)
Delivery of MRI conditional implantable pacemaker.  Led team through completion of scope, cost and schedule.  Delivered aggressive program 25% ahead of schedule and 20% under budget.  
	Vitatron A Series Pacemakers (Apr 2012 – Mar 2013)
Delivered four basic pacemakers as an initial step in revitalizing the Vitatron pacemaker brand.  Team was recognized with CRDM Radiate award for demonstrating exemplary project execution including project timelines, budget, quality, complexity, challenge, and innovation.
	Paceart Optima v1.0 (Oct 2010 – Mar 2012)
Completed large development program to deliver next generation enterprise clinic practice management SW product.  As Functional Director, re-structured the Development organization to meet challenging business objectives.

subComponents.title: Sr. SW Engineering Manager, SW Engineering Manager, Project Manager
subComponents.caption: Jun 2001 - Sep 2010 · 9 yrs 3 mos

description.text:
Project management of large SW systems and applications supporting implantable CRDM devices.  Several of the projects were amongst the largest SW undertakings in CRDM history.  Project development durations ranged from 1–5 years, with team sizes of 10-100 engineers. Staffing including outsourcing/offshoring with partners in Czech Republic, Ukraine, and India.  All Projects were implemented with well-defined development practices to ensure compliance with required quality and regulatory processes and standards.  Responsibility included creating project and development plans, product definition, staffing, budgeting, managing people, and project scheduling and tracking activity.  For SW projects that were part of a larger system, managed interfaces and integrated activities across organizations and functions.

+As Core Team Leader(Jul 2006–Jun 2009) and Dev Mgr(Jun 2005–Jul 2006), successfully replaced obsolete IBM OS/2 operating system with MS Windows on the external instrument that supports implant and follow up of implanted CRDM devices.  Ported two decades of business critical legacy SW applications

+As People manager of Managers and Engineers, conducted performance evaluations and provided ongoing coaching and mentoring  Last position included 40 total direct/ indirect reports (2000-2009)  

+As Dev Core Team member, added wired/wireless connectivity to automate transfer of patient’s implanted medical device data from programmer instrument to clinic management SW.  (2004 – 2005)

+As SW Mgr on extended development team for large device platform program, developed software for seven implanted devices via a flex software approach on multiple programmer instruments.   This project combined multiple SW organizations – people, processes and features (2001–2004)

+As SW Mgr for defibrillator platform project including new telemetry system and new programmer instrument HW, successfully delivered programmer application SW supporting Marquis DR/VR  (1996–2001)
